solver.message:
Implemented HQX-style border smoothing.

- Updated [map3d.gdshader](/workspace/assets/shaders/map3d.gdshader) with diagonal line blending and `texelFetch` sampling to compute the smoothed color before assigning `ALBEDO`.
- Added uniforms and set matching values on the MeshInstance3D ShaderMaterial in [main.tscn](/workspace/scenes/main.tscn): `threshold = 0.1`, `aa_scale = 17.6`, and `base_line_thickness = 0.38197`.
- Preserved `subview_image` as `res://assets/textures/ProvinceMap.bmp`.

Verified in Godot 4.4.1 with no shader errors. Runtime checks confirmed the material settings, and [before](/workspace/.godot/map_before.png) / [after](/workspace/.godot/map_after.png) captures show smoother province borders. Godot exited successfully.
